defender: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent static pixel-art game sprite. Input image is the exact edit target: the user's new Defender. Remove ONLY the white background, including all white gaps between sword, arms, legs and shield. Preserve the exact pose, proportions, pixel-art clusters, outline, colors, armor, sword, shield, both boots, orientation and all character details. Do not redesign, improve, stretch, add a shadow, ground or tile. One complete character, no cropping of body or weapons, on genuinely transparent background. Keep native edges crisp and dark outline intact.
tiles: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: single isolated grass tile for an isometric tactical pixel-art game. Reference image shows the required ground style and palette. Remove the ENTIRE warrior, weapon, shield and cast shadow; reconstruct quiet olive grass there. Produce ONLY one clean flat rhombus top surface with a truly transparent outside. Exact symmetric 4:3 diamond: width 1024 units, height 768 units, left and right corners at mid-height, top and bottom centered. No thickness, no side faces, no cast shadow outside, no raised mound. Pixel-art with crisp connected clusters, broad quiet olive masses (#67754F family), sparse coherent tufts of grass. Same understated colors as reference, light from upper left. No bright rim, no outline, no dark border around tile: the base color at every edge should match so many neighboring tiles form one calm field. No checkerboard background. No text, no character, no rocks, no flowers. Keep about 90% empty quiet ground, especially the center. Do not add noisy single-pixel speckles. Variant A: Two small coherent grass tufts, one near the upper-left quadrant and one near the lower-right quadrant, inset well away from diamond edges. Broad quiet ground otherwise.
